name: Upworksell.com

attribution.legal_posture: Identity/account marketplace described in a federal affidavit and later tied to its convicted operator

caveats: The 2024 source is a probable-cause affidavit; allegations about the service are distinct from Didenko’s later guilty plea and sentence.

sources.support: The affidavit describes UpWorkSell as a service for buying or renting false-identity freelance-platform, payment, credit-card, and SIM accounts and alleges that Didenko operated it
Oleksandr Didenko, also known as Alexander Didenko, was sentenced to 60 months; DOJ said Upworksell.com managed as many as 871 proxy identities and supported at least three laptop farms
sources.locator: Press release — opening and sentence paragraph; paragraph describing Upworksell.com, proxy identities, and laptop farms
